brief.zh: 把交来的字节依次送出，每个字节前加起始位 1，后加停止位 0；字节送完以后线上一直是 0。说「下一个」为 1 的那一拍取走眼前的字节，下一拍换上后一个。
brief.en: Send the bytes handed to you one after another, each with a start bit 1 before it and a stop bit 0 after; once they are all sent the wire stays 0. Saying next takes the byte in front of you that tick, and the following one shows the tick after.

t.zh: <level-ref to="1-9"></level-ref>收的是这样的字节，现在轮到发送一方。要送的字节排成一队，一次只看得见排在最前面的那一个；队伍空了，看到的是「—」。
t.en: <level-ref to="1-9"></level-ref> received bytes like these; now it is the sender's turn. The bytes to send wait in a queue, and only the one in front can be seen; once the queue is empty, it shows 「—」.
